description1.language: Located in Makkah, Holiday Inn Makkah Al Aziziah is a 5-star hotel offering air-conditioned accommodations with free Wi-Fi. Rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite channels, desks, safes, minibars, iPod docking stations, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel has 3 restaurants including Al Majad, 2 coffee shops/cafes, and offers 24-hour room service. A buffet breakfast is available. Guests can enjoy amenities such as 2 indoor swimming pools, a health club, a steam room, a terrace, a wellness area with a sauna and hot spring bath, a fitness center, a shared lounge, and a garden. The hotel provides free private parking, a 24-hour front desk, concierge services, limo/town car service, dry cleaning/laundry services, and free babysitting. A complimentary area shuttle and a complimentary shuttle bus service to and from Masjid Al Haram on Thursday and Friday are available. King Abdulaziz International Airport is nearby.

description1.language: Located in Makkah, Emaar Al Khalil offers air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs. It is situated approximately 650 meters from Masjid Al Haram. The hotel features a 24-hour front desk where staff speaking Arabic and English can assist guests. Complimentary wireless internet access is available. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Popular points of interest near the hotel include Zamzam Well and Masjid Al Haram King Fahd Gate. King Abdulaziz International Airport is 92 km away.

description1.language: Located in Mecca, Worth Elite Hotel is a 3-star hotel offering air-conditioned rooms with city views and free WiFi. Each room includes a desk, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom with free toiletries, bed linen, and towels. The hotel is located a short walk from the Great Mosque of Makkah and Abraj Al-Bait Towers, and 1.1 km from Masjid Al Haram and Kaaba. Amenities include a 24-hour front desk with English and French-speaking staff, luggage storage, concierge services, an elevator, and complimentary wireless internet access. King Abdulaziz International Airport is 92 km away.

description1.language: Hotel 21 Makkah offers air-conditioned guestrooms with complimentary wireless internet access, phones, safes, and blackout drapes/curtains. The hotel features a restaurant, a business center, and a 24-hour front desk. Coffee and tea are available in a common area. Buffet breakfasts are served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. description1.language: Ideally located in the Ajyad district of Makkah, Mira Ajyad Hotel is less than 1 km from Masjid Al Haram, 4.4 km from Abraj Al Bait and 9 km from Makkah Mall. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant and a 24-hour front desk. Around the clock and room service, in addition to free WiFi throughout, the property offers a shared lounge area, a concierge service and currency exchange for guests. All guest rooms at this hotel are air conditioned and come with a seating area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a bidet, a hairdryer and free toiletries. The rooms at Mira Ajyad Hotel also include bed linen and towels. Hira Cave is 9 km from the accommodation, while Mount Arafat is 21 km away. The nearest airport is King Abdulaziz International Airport, 99 km from Mira Ajyad Hotel.

description1.language: Batoul Ajyad Hotel offers modern, air-conditioned accommodations in Mecca, 1200 meters from the Holy Haram and Abraj Al-Bait Towers. Each of the 298 rooms includes Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV with cable programming, a mini-fridge, a safety deposit box, and an electric kettle. Private bathrooms feature a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. The hotel provides a restaurant, coffee shop, and room service (during limited hours). A buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a television in a common area. A 24-hour shuttle bus service to and from the Holy Haram is available. The multilingual reception staff speaks Arabic, English, and Urdu. Limited parking is available. King Abdulaziz International Airport is 85 km away.

description1.language: Located in Makkah, Emaar International is a 1-star hotel offering air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms. It features a restaurant and designated smoking areas. Complimentary wireless internet access is available. Each room is equipped with a flat-screen TV, a kettle, and a hairdryer. Conveniences include a safe, and irons/ironing boards can be requested. Housekeeping is provided daily. The hotel is non-smoking. The 24-hour front desk staff speaks Arabic and English and can provide information about the area. Luggage storage is available. Masjid Al-Jinn is 1.1 km away, while the Great Mosque of Makkah and Kaaba are within 5.7 km. King Abdulaziz International Airport is 91.6-95 km away.
